Counting the raw # selection instead made the label read "Save Network" while # the panel saved a two-node selection. sel = [i for i in hou.selectedItems() if i.parent() == n.parent()] if not any(i == n for i in sel): sel = sel + [n] whole = (n.type().name() in TYPES and n.childTypeCategory().name() in KINDS and bool(n.children()) and len(sel) <= 1) except AttributeError: whole = False return "Save to " + _APP
